purpose: Bounded real-data preflight and proposed FP32/BF16 continuation from the fold-0 combo checkpoint under the fixed alpha=.5, horizon-8 stopped-bootstrap objective.

split.group_order: seeded_group_batches(groups, seed=3, epoch=e, batch_size=32); serialize and record group_batch_sha256 per epoch; both arms reuse the same preloaded batches byte-for-byte

data.feature_builder: raw112 || event_features(raw112), exact NumPy counterpart of trainer build_inputs with optional blocks disabled
data.teacher_row_identity: sidecar row_groups, ordered exactly as prediction array; both caches must match fold-0 manifest hash and row order
data.cache_gate: require prediction arrays and sidecars for both train and valid, exact checkpoint epoch, split hash, row-group mapping, and content hash; fail closed if absent

objective.primary: weighted MSE on fixed SBD target: teacher is equal mean at t; substitute equal-mean teacher(t+8) for y only when the target pair remains unchanged through t+8; blend 0.5*bootstrap_label + 0.5*teacher(t); weights abs(clip(original_y,-2,2))*main_row_weights

ema_consistency.teacher: incoming EMA initialized from the same epoch-3 checkpoint; one-update preflight uses a separate recurrent state initialized to zero; consistency uses main_row_weights divided by their row sum

aux_struct.labels: original target labels; same row weights and denominators as train_rnn.py

aux_next.labels: original target D=t0-t1 next-change distance/sign; masked when no later change; same row weights and denominators as train_rnn.py

objective.row_weights: warmup99 * (prop_v1**2 + 0.03), per-sequence valid_true_mask=0.03 renormalization on scored VALID sequences, then since_i0px decay scale=32 floor=0.25
objective.distillation_targets: fixed before device training; no validation/evaluation targets enter the fit batches

shared_training.architecture: ordinary stacked linear GRU; n_in=211, hidden=256, layers=2, n_out=23
shared_training.optimizer: custom JAX AdamW, explicitly not Muon-equivalent
shared_training.initial_state_npz: artifacts/runs/c20261003_combo_s3_f0/model_ep3.jax.npz; export this exact checkpoint using a root-owned bounded CPU conversion before running
shared_training.checkpoint: export Torch-named state tensors through export_npz_state; evaluate both arms with the exact same fold evaluation group list and official need_prediction AND is_scored mask

preflight.scope: single device, four fit streams (2 TRAIN and 2 VALID) for one 1000-row chunk, run FP32 and BF16 serially on the identical host batch, one AdamW update each with incoming EMA consistency, evaluate the same four fold-held-out VALID streams on rows 0:1000, export/reload both NPZ states, exact official-mask equality
preflight.status: not run; source-only staging, no local JAX imports or launches

blockers: The exact Torch combo checkpoint is known; its staged NPZ export is still required and must hash back to the checkpoint's state tensors.
Current trainer checkpoint-selection evaluates is_scored plus warm-up; this bridge's official score mask also includes need_prediction, so select one shared mask policy before sealing.
The JAX AdamW objective preserves losses and weights but is an optimizer change from E424 Muon, so these arms only isolate precision within the JAX implementation.
